verdict.rationale: Runloop documents an official CLI, `rli`, with both an interactive terminal UI and traditional commands for managing resources. Documented uses include automatic SSH setup into devboxes, building blueprints from Dockerfiles, and submitting and comparing agent benchmark jobs, and a probe confirms the official CLI docs page. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and evidence of agent-oriented CLI features such as machine-readable output or non-interactive scripting guidance.
